title: Equal Reachable-State Counts Preserve All Runs
statement:
Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with a finite state set, a fixed finite number $k$ of work tapes, and binary input $x$. For each space bound $s$, encode configurations using the state, output summary, work-tape contents and head positions in the window $[-s,s]$, together with the input-head position. Let $R_s$ be the set of codes below $2^{(2W+2)(s+
u(|x|)+1)}$ reachable from the initial configuration by a finite sequence of valid one-step transitions whose source and target configurations use only work-tape cells in $[-s,s]$, where $W=3|	ext{states}|+3k+4$ and $
u(n)= loor{
log_2 n}+1$. If $|R_s|=|R_{s+1}|$, then every finite sequence of nondeterministic choices, when run on $x$, has every prefix configuration using only work-tape cells in $[-s,s]$.
